subject: Temporary no-PO onboarding route for StreamVault pilot — controls and signoff
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@streamvault.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@streamvault.io
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot onboarding — PO? (StreamVault)

Hi Naomi and Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Were excited to run the two-week integration pilot with your team. Procurement at StreamVault normally requires a PO for any vendor invoices, but for short pilots we sometimes route invoices through accounts@streamvault.io without a PO to speed start dates.

Quick questions:
- Is Redwood able to accept an invoice for the pilot without an issued PO if we provide a signed SOW and payment terms?
- If not, is there a temporary pathway you use for pilots (short-term invoice-only)?

I attached the SOW and our supplier intake survey; happy to provide anything else your team needs. Were hoping to invoice on completion of the pilot (14 days).

Appreciate the guidance — Alicia

--
Alicia Ramos
Head of Partnerships, StreamVault
alicia@streamvault.io | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: StreamVault_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF), streamvault-risk-survey.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@streamvault.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO? (StreamVault)

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for sending — weve reviewed the SOW and the intake survey. Short answer: we do have an established temporary invoice-only lane for short pilots, but it requires a few controls before finance will approve. To move quickly, can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?

- Signed SOW (weve got v1 but need the signatory name & date)
- A point-of-contact in StreamVault finance who will accept the invoice and confirm the payment timeline
- Confirmation you will not exceed the pilot not-to-exceed amount of $7,500 without pre-approval

If you can provide those, I will open a procurement exception request and route to Finance for a 14-day invoice-only approval.

Marissa  Im looping you for commercial confirmation (pilot scope and not-to-exceed amount). Also tagging Laura for procurement ops to own the exception workflow.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0143

Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO? (StreamVault)

Hi team,

Procurement ops has reviewed the SOW and the intake answers. We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding lane for StreamVaults pilot under the following conditions:

1) StreamVault sends a countersigned SOW to procurement@redwood.com with the finance POC listed (name + email).
2) Pilot invoices must be titled "StreamVault - Pilot Invoice" and sent to accounts@redwood.com; Redwood will process via the temporary lane within our standard Net30 payment terms from invoice receipt.
3) Total pilot spend capped at $7,500. Any change above that requires a written email approval from Naomi (Procurement Lead) and finance.
4) StreamVault completes the attached vendor risk quick-check (well accept the one they already sent but need the completed fields filled in).
5) Exception approval will be logged in our procurement tracker and is valid for 30 days from approval.

If Alicia confirms the signatory and finance contact and uploads the signed SOW, I will add the exception and mark this request approved.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
